follow-up time: Through pregnancy and early postpartum period
exposure: Matsuda index below the 50th percentile of women with normal glucose tolerance (NGT)
outcome: glucose intolerance in the early postpartum period
finding: Pregnant women with GDM and high insulin resistance have a greater risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, such as preterm delivery and neonatal hypoglycaemia, compared to women with NGT or insulin-sensitive GDM.
mod_finding: Women with GDM and high insulin resistance had higher rates of Caesarean section (total and emergency) compared to women with NGT.
